1.20.1.3.4.3: A Projectile spell with an imported Iron's glyph that misses no longer blocks that Iron's spell for a minute, and Iron's cooldown now also applies where the glyph lands, so two projectiles give one effect and one payment. Also ships the never-published 3.4.1 and 3.4.2: imported glyphs follow Iron's live server settings (maximum level, school, learning) and equipment level bonuses, every spell reserves levels up to 10 for servers that raise the maximum, and Iron's addon spells can get glyphs through catalog packages; the Ars spellbook gets an Iron's glyphs bookmark that groups learned levels by spell; delayed, projectile and charged imported glyphs can no longer run for free after a Virtue Ring comes off, and fake players can no longer cast them; Spell Uninscription works on bound books again; HYBRID honours Ars Mana Regen potions, an End return keeps category cooldowns, and cross-system regeneration converts correctly away from the default settings. Network protocol 11: client and server both need 3.4.3.
1.20.1.3.4.0: Touch spells cast from exported Iron's scrolls, inscribed items and bound Iron's books now hit the block or creature you aim at, exactly as from an Ars spell book; a Touch cast with nothing in reach is refused without spending mana, training a school or starting a cooldown. With Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks installed, every Iron's player spell becomes a learnable Ars glyph for each of its levels (111 spells, 777 glyphs), made in the new Glyph Press from a filled Iron's scroll. Also ships the never-published 3.3.7 changes: in iss_primary, the default mode, Iron's max mana now holds Ars's own maximum, and the Spell Loom can give a custom Ars spell a chosen spell school. Network protocol 8: client and server both need 3.4.0.
1.20.1.3.3.2: Fixes the contextual Iron's mana bar staying visible at full displayed mana when the maximum is fractional. Preserves held casting items, Always/Never settings, and XP-bar restoration. Matching fix on Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1. No config, network protocol, or save-format changes from 3.3.1.
1.20.1.3.2.4: Server performance release. The Mana Well ritual no longer scans every entity section in range on every tick while lit; per-tick handlers stop querying Forge's ModList each player tick; the shared-pool mana ceiling no longer rewrites Iron's MAX_MANA modifier (and broadcasts an attribute packet) every regen interval when nothing changed; resonance is synced to the client only when it changes. No gameplay, config, packet or save-format changes.
1.20.1.3.2.3: Fixes Ars 'n' Spells rituals doing nothing at all. Placing a Spellbook Binding, Spell Transcription, Spell Uninscription or Mana Infusion tablet on a ritual brazier and lighting it consumed nothing, produced nothing and reported nothing - the brazier just stayed lit. These rituals never told Ars they had finished, so their payload never ran; they have been inert since 3.0.0. They now burn for about three seconds and complete. Ritual messages also reach the player who lit the brazier instead of being dropped if they walked away, /ans bind_scroll_to_irons_book now honours allow_ars_spells_in_irons_spellbooks, and the binding instructions have been corrected in game and in the docs.
1.20.1.3.2.2: Fixes fake "Ars 'n' Spells" spell scrolls turning up in Iron's Spellbooks loot - exploration chests, Mystery Scroll Pouches, magic-mob drops and wandering traders. These were the mod's internal ars_cross_* proxy spells, which do nothing outside a spellbook that carries the matching Ars spell. Ars 'n' Spells does not modify any loot table; the proxies simply never opted out of Iron's random-spell pool, and now do. A stray scroll already in your world becomes a blank Iron's scroll the first time you right-click it, and the eight missing spell-description translations have been added.
1.20.1.3.2.1: Fixes a mixin conflict that stopped the game from loading at all when One Mana Bar was installed, taking twelve mods down with it. Failures in the optional Iron's and Covenant integrations now degrade to a warning instead of aborting startup for the whole pack. Iron's scrolls have been casting completely free in every previous build - scroll cost enforcement now actually applies, so scrolls cost whatever scroll_cost_mode says (default: the same as casting normally).
1.20.1.3.2.0: Fixes one Ars spell draining the entire mana pool on hybrid mode, ritual tablets rendering as the missing-texture checkerboard, and a client crash when hovering a Spell Loom scroll. Adds the Mana Infusion and Mana Well ritual tablets, which had no item and could never be placed on a brazier.
1.20.1.3.1.0: Fixes the Iron's Inscription Table crash on exported scrolls (client AND server), orphan wheel entries left by unbinding, free Ars casts when the Virtue Ring system is disabled, and ars_cross_* ghosts in JEI/EMI. Spell schools now come from Ars Nouveau's own metadata, and removing an addon fails loudly instead of silently changing a bound spell.
1.20.1.3.0.3: Cross-cast fixes: a bound Ars spell equipped in the Curios spellbook slot now casts (it silently did nothing), binding rolls back instead of half-succeeding, Iron's affinity/cooldown/LP/progression no longer double-bill proxy casts, and unreadable payloads are refused before anything is consumed.
1.20.1.3.0.2: Affinity decay curve fix (~20x too fast), datapack tags for rings/blasphemies/source jars, Spell Loom advancement chain and screen readability, aura_failure_mode, config-driven progression curve.
1.20.1.3.0.1: Audit remediation: fixed uncraftable ritual tablets with Iron's loaded (item tag), config screen readability, Iron's-less boot crash fix, LP toggle gating.
1.20.1.3.0.0: Cross-cast inscription: export Ars spells onto Iron's scrolls and bind them into Iron's spellbooks via the Spell Loom.

1.21.1.3.4.3: A Projectile spell with an imported Iron's glyph that misses no longer blocks that Iron's spell or uses up one of your active casts, and Iron's cooldown is checked where the glyph lands, so two projectiles give one effect and one payment; the same glyph twice in one spell now runs twice. Also ships the never-published 3.4.1 and 3.4.2: imported glyphs follow Iron's live server settings (maximum level, school, learning) and equipment level bonuses, native recasts are free again, every spell reserves levels up to 10 for servers that raise the maximum, and Iron's addon spells can get glyphs through catalog packages; the Ars spellbook gets an Iron's glyphs bookmark that groups learned levels by spell; fake players can no longer cast imported glyphs; Spell Uninscription works on bound books again; HYBRID honours Ars Mana Regen potions, and cross-system regeneration delivers the same mana per second in both directions. Network protocol 13: client and server both need 3.4.3.

The new Glyph Press turns a filled Iron's scroll into a learnable Ars glyph for that spell at that level: every ordinary player spell of Iron's 3.16.3 has glyphs, 111 spells and 777 glyphs in all. Also ships the never-published 3.3.7 changes: iss_primary max mana no longer drops after updating from 3.3.4, and the Spell Loom can give a custom Ars spell a chosen spell school. Network protocol 9: client and server both need 3.4.0.

Ritual messages and the binding advancement now go to the player who lit the brazier instead of whoever happened to be nearest when it finished, or being dropped entirely if they walked away. /ans bind_scroll_to_irons_book now honours allow_ars_spells_in_irons_spellbooks instead of bypassing the kill switch. On the performance side the Mana Well ritual no longer scans every entity section in range on every tick while lit, and the per-tick regen path no longer queries the mod list each player tick. No gameplay, config, packet or save-format changes.
1.21.1.3.2.2: Parity with the Forge 1.20.1 3.2.2 line. Fixes fake "Ars 'n' Spells" spell scrolls turning up in Iron's Spellbooks loot - exploration chests, Mystery Scroll Pouches, magic-mob drops and wandering traders. These were the mod's internal ars_cross_* proxy spells, which do nothing outside a spellbook that carries the matching Ars spell. Ars 'n' Spells does not modify any loot table; the proxies simply never opted out of Iron's random-spell pool, and now do. 1.21.1.3.2.1: Parity with the Forge 1.20.1 3.2.1 line. Fixes a mixin conflict that could stop an entire modpack from loading: adjusting the mana value Iron's reads inside canBeCastedBy used an injection aimed at one specific instruction, and a mod that replaces that whole method made it fatal. It now uses only HEAD and RETURN injection points, which Mixin permits into a replaced method by design. Mixins targeting Iron's Spellbooks - an optional dependency - moved into a non-required config, so a conflict there logs a warning and skips one mixin instead of aborting startup for every mod in the chain. Also fixes uninscription leaving unusable entries in the spell wheel, the Spell Transcription ritual destroying stacked source scrolls, ARS_PRIMARY deleting mana above Iron's own ceiling, and three ritual tablets rendering with Ars Nouveau's art. Requires NeoForge 21.1+, Ars Nouveau 5.13+; Iron's Spellbooks 3.16.3+ optional.
1.21.1.3.2.0: Parity with the Forge 1.20.1 3.2.0 line. Adds the mod's own creative tab, makes the Mana Infusion and Mana Well tablets obtainable, and fixes one Ars spell draining the entire mana pool in hybrid mode. Restores server-authoritative cross-casting, the Inscription Table crash guard (client AND server), payload-integrity checks that refuse a spell whose glyphs are gone, the Curios spellbook-slot cast fix, proxy double-billing short-circuits, the scroll cost system, and school classification from Ars Nouveau's own metadata. Requires NeoForge 21.1+, Ars Nouveau 5.13+.
